title: Gate discovery table
description: Rows that map a repository signal to the tool and command that fill one PROJECT_COMMANDS quality-gate slot. Within one (language, slot) pair the first matching row in file order wins. Enforced locally by speckit_pro_runner/gate_discovery.py (standard library); this file documents the same rules.

path.description: Repository-relative path whose existence selects the row. No leading slash, no '..' segment.

command.description: Written into the slot. Placeholders allowed: {ceiling}, {complexity_ceiling}, {floor}, {survival_ceiling}, {rules_path}, {paths}.
